i1.title: Jaguar Era Reloaded Eau de Parfum 100ml
i1.descriptionHtml:
Bright citrus over a warm, spiced amber trail.

Jaguar Era Reloaded Eau de Parfum 100ml is an amber fragrance for men with a fresh citrus opening, launched in 2024. Sicilian lemon, Brazilian orange and crisp apple open it bright and juicy, a heart of jasmine, pink pepper and nutmeg adds a lively spice, and it settles into a warm base of cedarwood, vanilla, sandalwood and amber.

Scent pyramid

  • Top: Lemon, Orange, Apple
  • Heart: Jasmine, Pink Pepper, Nutmeg
  • Base: Cedarwood, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Amber

Key details

  • Brand: Jaguar
  • Concentration: Eau de Parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Scent profile: Amber · Citrus · Spicy
  • Wear: Men

Why you'll love it

  • A bright lemon, orange and apple opening
  • A lively jasmine, pink pepper and nutmeg heart
  • A warm cedarwood, vanilla and amber base
  • Generous 100ml Eau de Parfum

FAQ

What does Era Reloaded smell like?

Lemon, orange and apple first, then jasmine, pink pepper and nutmeg, finishing with cedarwood, vanilla, sandalwood and amber.

Is it for men?

Yes, it is a men's fragrance.

i10.title: Karl Lagerfeld Classic Aftershave Lotion 100ml
